title: Ravi Karta Hai Bayan
body:
Sughra sughra Sughra Haaye Sughra s.a....3
Ravi Karta hai bayan is tarah haale Sughra...4
Fatema Sughra ek khat shahe wala ko likha
Ek bimar ne haal apne masiha ko likha
Dard o ghum huzn o Alam beti ne baba ko likha
Ek Bichdi hui khwahar ne ye bhaiyya ko likha
Ravi....2
Mai tadapti hu ghum e hijr se pyare baba
Lo khabar jald hamari aey hamare baba
Aap jabse hain Madine se sidhare baba
Dhundle dhundle nazar aate hain nazare baba..
Ravi.....2
Bhaiyya Akbar se kaho bhul gaye kya wada
Waqt e Ruksat ye kaha tha mai zarur aaunga
Baith jati hu mai darwaze pe har subho masa
Intezar unka mai Karti hu abhi tak baba..
Ravi..2
Is tarah se to bahen ko na bhulana bhaiyya
Kya zaruri tha mujhe aise rulana bhaiyya
Bhul baitha hai mujhe sara gharana bhaiyya
Mujh ko acha nahi lagta ye zamana bhaiyya
Ravi.....2
Meri bimari ka aa pahocha Zamana bhaiyya
Maut ka meri na ban jaye bahana bhaiyya
Ab jo aana to meri Qabr pe aana bhaiyya
Ilteja hai ke Dulhan sath me lana bhaiyya
Ravi.....2
Leke khat Qasid e Sughra ba dil e yas chala
Roz Ashur tha jab Karbobala me pahocha
Koi Nasir bhi na tha Shah Khade the tanha
Khat e Sughra Shahe Zeeshah ko Qasid ne diya
Ravi......2
Khat jo dekha to Shahenshah e Zaman rone lage
Lashe Akbar Jahan rakhi thi wahan ja pahoche
Rakh ke khat seena e Akbar pe Shahe deen bole
Utho Akbar tumhe Sughra ka payam aaya hai
Ravi. ....2
Kon us Khat ka Jawab us ghadi deta Majid
Qafela Qaid se Yasrab me jo Pahocha Majid
Ek Abid ke siwa koi na lauta Majid
Mil gaya khud hi jawab e Khat e Sughra Majid
Ravi ...2
